subject: Renewal paperwork: staged term swap + capacity ladder — redline Q&A
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie@novus.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, procurement@novus.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal paperwork — term change & capacity ladder questions

Marcus — thanks for the call this morning. We're aligned on the overall upsell, but procurement asked for a consolidated view of the paperwork changes before we loop our finance and legal teams. High-level asks: 

- Move contract term from 18 months to 24 months, but with a staged capacity ladder (year 1: baseline 50M tokens, year 2: 80M tokens).
- Clarify whether the MSA needs an amendment or if the order form + addendum covers the term swap.
- We need explicit language for overage handling and a short path for temporary burst capacity during onboarding.

I've attached our proposed order form (Novus_proposed_orderform_v3.pdf) with inline comments. Can your legal ops redline the MSA and the order form and confirm the minimal sign path (order form only vs. MSA + order form)? Procurement would like to close by Nov 30 to hit FY28 planning.

Thanks — happy to hop on a follow-up if helpful.

—Jamie Park
Head of Cloud Integrations | Novus AI
jamie@novus.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachment: Novus_proposed_orderform_v3.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@novus.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, procurement@novus.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — term change & capacity ladder questions

Jamie — appreciate the detail and the attached order form. Quick note on next steps from our side:

1) I'll put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) outlining review milestones and sign-off owners. Draft attached (MAP_draft_Novus_20271118.docx).
2) Looping Legal (Kimberly) and Sales Ops (Laura) to confirm whether an MSA amendment is required vs. order form + addendum. If Kim determines MSA changes are needed, legal will produce a redline MSA + order form.
3) I'll aim to get a preliminary redline back by Monday (Nov 22) so you and your procurement/legal can review before the Thanksgiving week.

Two clarifying Qs for procurement to save cycles:
- For the capacity ladder, do you want a fixed guaranteed baseline with a separate optional burst pool (metered) or a soft ramp with built-in overage rate?
- Is there a preferred invoice cadence (annual vs. upfront + renewal credit)?

If helpful let's hold a 30-min legal coordination call next Monday — propose 10am PT. LMK if that works.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachment: MAP_draft_Novus_20271118.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie@novus.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — term change & capacity ladder questions

Marcus / Jamie — a couple of quick operational notes from Sales Ops that should help Legal scope the edits: 

- We recommend a guaranteed baseline (50M tokens) with a separate "Burst Pool" SKU at a defined overage rate to preserve predictability for Novus; language suggestion: 
  • Baseline Commitment: Customer commits to 50,000,000 tokens per 12-month period.
  • Burst Pool: Additional tokens billed at $0.0008 per token, invoiced monthly; available up to 30% of baseline per month.

- Term: propose an MSA amendment that flips term to 24 months and references the updated order form; this keeps historical protections in the MSA intact (indemnities, data handling).

- Billing cadence: Provide a credit schedule option on invoice (upfront credit for 12 months with carryforward for usage) — procurement historically prefers predictable CAPEX treatment.

Jamie — can you confirm whether the Novus preferred PO flow requires a separate signature on the MSA amendment or whether a signed order form referencing the amendment is sufficient? If procurement wants both signatures we can surface that as an option in the MAP.

Thanks — looping Kim for legal redlines.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@novus.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — term change & capacity ladder questions (Redlines attached)

Jamie / Marcus / Laura — thanks for the MAP and the proposed order form. Legal has done an initial pass. Summary of redline decisions and open items: 

1) MSA amendment vs. order form: we recommend an amendment to the MSA toggling the primary term to 24 months and adding a one-sentence cross-reference to the updated order form for capacity/ladders. Rationale: preserves previously negotiated indemnities and security language without re-stating in each order form.

2) Overage/burst handling: added a Burst Pool definition in the order form and a short cap on burst usage (30% of baseline/month) to limit financial exposure. Overages will be billed at the proposed $0.0008 per token and subject to monthly invoicing.

3) Sign path: we can support either: (A) signed MSA amendment + signed order form, or (B) single signed order form that expressly references and incorporates a signed amendment acceptance checkbox. Procurement preference will determine final path.

4) Data retention and export: updated Exhibit C (data handling) to explicitly clarify retention windows for ephemeral logs and model telemetry — minor changes, acceptable to Novus but FYI if they have strict audit windows.

5) SLOs and credits: we preserved the existing SLO credit structure and added one clause clarifying that any change in capacity tiers does not modify availability SLOs unless explicitly amended.

Open items we need Novus to confirm before we finalize redlines: 
- Preferred sign path (A vs. B above).
- Confirmation on invoice cadence (annual upfront credit vs. monthly billing).
- Whether procurement wants a separate Attachment for PO flow.

I've attached the marked-up MSA and order form for your review: Novus_MSA_redline_20271120.docx, Novus_OrderForm_redline_20271120.pdf. Please review and get back with procurement's sign preference and billing cadence. If all looks good, we can publish a DocuSign envelope and target execution by Nov 30.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: Novus_MSA_redline_20271120.docx (DOCX, 85KB); Novus_OrderForm_redline_20271120.pdf (PDF, 132KB)
